header.title: Suppl. Mag. 24: amulet (protective incantation) with exorcism against demons with mention of Solomon: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64726:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1.1: A fragmentary amulet. Underdotted letters in the edition are doubtful, including parts of 'I adjure' (1.1, 1.3). In 1.3 the scribe wrote and deleted the misspelling ὀκκίζω, kept here as ⟦okkizō⟧. The word ends -son, -gmous, -an.., -ōros, -kess- and '.louan' (2.2) cannot be identified. '.λ.βεν' (2.1–2) is read doubtfully as ἔλαβεν, 'took'. 2.5: 'you' is plural and the verb 'harm' singular, as written; 'ser[vant]' is feminine.
